title: OpenUSD official documentation
use: Scene composition and schemas, distinguished from a dynamics solver or machine control implementation.
label: OpenUSD 官方文档
use_zh: 区分场景描述、组合和 physics schema 与物理求解／设备行为

title: OPC UA for Machine Tools, Part 1 — Information Model Overview
use: Machine identification, monitoring, production, equipment and notification semantics; no assumption that every machine exposes low-level control.
label: OPC UA for Machine Tools, Part 1
use_zh: 核对设备识别／监控／生产／装备／通知模型；不推断任意设备控制能力

title: MTConnect Part 2 — Device Information Model, 2.1.0
use: Physical/logical device configuration and observation semantics; not treated as a control bus.
label: MTConnect Device Information Model 2.1.0
use_zh: 设备物理／逻辑配置与观测语义，采用固定版本文档

title: Functional Mock-up Interface Specification, 3.0.2
use: Model Exchange, Co-Simulation and Scheduled Execution; synchronization algorithm remains a separate responsibility.
label: FMI 3.0.2
use_zh: 模型交换、协同仿真、调度执行的接口边界；非完整工厂同步算法

title: OpenUSD — UsdGeomMesh Class Reference
use: Time-varying point and topology attributes; distinguish scene description from cutting dynamics.
label: UsdGeomMesh
use_zh: 时间相关的点／拓扑属性；场景表达与物理求解的区别

title: PhysX SDK 5.8.0 — Deformable Volume
use: Topology changes from tearing/cutting require updating precomputed collision, mass/volume and mesh mappings.
label: PhysX 5.8.0 Deformable Volume
use_zh: 切割／撕裂改变拓扑时需更新碰撞、质量与映射等预计算数据

title: ovphysx SDK — Deformable Bodies
use: Implementation-specific restrictions on deformable simulation, collision and rest-shape topology; not a universal USD limitation.
label: ovphysx Deformable Bodies
use_zh: 具体后端对仿真／碰撞／rest shape 的限制；不外推至全部 USD／PhysX

title: NVIDIA Blog — Mega Omniverse Blueprint (CES, 2025-01-06)
label: NVIDIA Mega Omniverse Blueprint
use: Definition of Mega as a blueprint for developing, testing and optimizing physical AI and robot fleets in a digital twin; a world simulator coordinates robot activities and sensor data. No performance data or limitations are published.
use_zh: Mega 的定位：在数字孪生中开发、测试和优化机器人车队；由世界模拟器协调各机器人活动和传感器数据。官方未给出性能数据或局限

title: NVIDIA press release — Mega blueprint expanded to factory digital twins (2025-10-28)
label: NVIDIA 新闻稿：Mega 扩展到工厂数字孪生
use: Announces that the Mega blueprint is expanded with technologies for designing and simulating factory digital twins; Siemens named as the first supporter.
use_zh: Mega 扩展到工厂数字孪生的设计与仿真；厂商公告，不是技术评测

title: Striffler & Voigt, Concepts and trends of virtual commissioning – A comprehensive review, Journal of Manufacturing Systems 71 (2023) 664–680, DOI 10.1016/j.jmsy.2023.10.013
label: 虚拟调试综述（Striffler & Voigt, 2023）
use: Further reading on virtual commissioning. The publisher blocked automated download, so only Crossref metadata (title, authors, CC BY 4.0 licence) was checked; no claims in this report rely on its full text.
use_zh: 虚拟调试的延伸阅读。出版方拒绝自动下载，只核对了 Crossref 元数据（题名、作者、CC BY 4.0 许可）；本报告没有引用其正文内容

title: Yann LeCun, A Path Towards Autonomous Machine Intelligence (Version 0.9.2, 2022-06-27), OpenReview
label: LeCun：A Path Towards Autonomous Machine Intelligence（2022）
use: Position paper proposing JEPA-style world models that predict in an abstract representation space and support hierarchical planning. OpenReview blocks automated fetching; identity confirmed via the indexed PDF and an archive mirror.
use_zh: JEPA 路线的立场论文：在抽象表示空间里预测，并支持分层规划。OpenReview 拒绝自动抓取，通过索引的 PDF 与存档镜像核对身份

title: AMI Labs (Advanced Machine Intelligence) — company website
label: AMI Labs 官网
use: States the goal "to build intelligent systems that understand the real world" and that AMI develops world models learning abstract representations of sensor data; offices in Paris, New York, Montreal and Singapore; founders include Yann LeCun.
use_zh: 公司目标“构建理解真实世界的智能系统”，开发在抽象表示空间里预测的世界模型；创始团队包括 Yann LeCun

title: Tech.eu, Yann LeCun’s Paris-based AI world model startup raises more than $1BN (2026-03-10)
label: Tech.eu：AMI Labs 融资报道（2026-03-10）
use: Reports that AMI Labs raised $1.03bn at a $3.5bn valuation.
use_zh: 报道 AMI Labs 以 35 亿美元估值融资 10.3 亿美元

title: Fei-Fei Li, From Words to Worlds: Spatial Intelligence is AI’s Next Frontier (Substack, 2025-11-10)
label: Fei-Fei Li：From Words to Worlds（2025-11-10）
use: Frames world models as generative (perceptual, geometric and physical consistency), multimodal, and interactive (next state from input actions).
use_zh: 空间智能路线的纲领性文章：世界模型应具备生成（感知、几何、物理一致）、多模态、交互（根据动作输出下一状态）三种能力

title: World Labs, Marble general release (2025-11-12)
label: World Labs：Marble 发布（2025-11-12）
use: Marble creates 3D worlds from text, images, video or coarse layouts; exports Gaussian splats, collider meshes for coarse physics, high-quality meshes, and videos; interactivity is described as future work; no per-object separation is described.
use_zh: Marble 由文本、图像、视频或粗布局生成三维世界，可导出高斯、粗物理用碰撞网格、高质量网格和视频；交互列为未来工作，未提及按对象分离

title: World Labs Docs — Marble export specs
label: Marble 导出规格
use: SPZ/PLY splats (~2M, low-res ~500k); collider GLB 100–200k triangles for simple physics; high-quality GLB ~600k textured or ~1M vertex-coloured, up to an hour to generate; 2560×1280 panorama. All exports cover the whole world.
use_zh: 高斯约 200 万（低配约 50 万）；碰撞网格 GLB 10–20 万三角面，用于简单物理；高质量网格最长约 1 小时生成；所有导出都是整个世界，没有按对象导出

title: World Labs, RTFM: A Real-Time Frame Model (2025-10-16)
label: World Labs：RTFM（2025-10-16）
use: Autoregressive diffusion transformer over frames; runs at interactive framerates on a single H100; no explicit 3D representation; dynamics and interaction listed as future work. No fps figure given.
use_zh: 逐帧自回归扩散 Transformer，单张 H100 上以“交互帧率”运行（未给具体帧率）；不用显式三维；动态与交互列为未来工作

title: World Labs, Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence (2026-09-01)
label: World Labs：Atlas（2026-09-01）
use: Takes text, images, camera poses and depth; outputs up to 1 minute of 1440p video, per-frame depth, point clouds or 3D Gaussian splats; early access only; no speed figures.
use_zh: 输入文本、图像、相机位姿和深度，输出最长 1 分钟 1440p 视频、逐帧深度、点云或三维高斯；早期访问，未给速度数据

title: World Labs, Frameboy: Atlas in Real-time (2026-11-05)
label: World Labs：Frameboy（2026-11-05）
use: Streams Atlas frames from cloud GPUs to the browser at up to 15 fps; must run on a powerful cloud GPU server.
use_zh: Atlas 从云端 GPU 流式输出，最高 15 fps；必须在云端高性能 GPU 服务器上运行

title: World Labs, Building Worlds That Train Robots — real-to-sim-to-real (2026-07-28)
label: World Labs：real-to-sim-to-real（2026-07-28）
use: Proprietary real-to-sim-to-real engine combining generated environments with task-aligned robot simulation; ALOHA, YAM, RB-Y1, Flexiv and xArm tasks; the simulator is not named and no numeric success rates appear in the text.
use_zh: 自有的 real-to-sim-to-real 引擎，把生成的环境与机器人任务仿真结合；未说明底层物理引擎，正文未给数值成功率

title: World Labs, World Labs is Joining AMD (2026-09-28)
label: World Labs 加入 AMD（2026-09-28）
use: Definitive agreement to join AMD, expected to close by the end of 2026 subject to regulatory approvals.
use_zh: 已签署加入 AMD 的最终协议，预计 2026 年底完成，尚需监管批准

title: Google DeepMind, Genie 2: A large-scale foundation world model (2024-12-04)
label: Google DeepMind：Genie 2（2024-12-04）
use: Consistent worlds for up to a minute, most examples 10–20 s; a distilled version plays in real time with reduced quality; no frame rate given.
use_zh: 一致性最长约 1 分钟，多数示例 10–20 秒；蒸馏版可实时运行但质量下降；未给帧率

title: Google DeepMind, Genie 3: A new frontier for world models (2025-08-05)
label: Google DeepMind：Genie 3（2025-08-05）
use: Real-time navigation at 24 fps, 720p; consistency for a few minutes with visual memory of about one minute; constrained action space; a few minutes of continuous interaction; multi-agent interaction still a research challenge.
use_zh: 实时 24 fps、720p；一致性维持数分钟，视觉记忆约 1 分钟；动作空间受限；连续交互约数分钟；多智能体交互仍是难题

title: Google DeepMind, Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation (2026-10-27)
label: Google DeepMind：Genie 4（2026-10-27）
use: Real-time interactive simulation with native audio and live language edits; robot demonstrations with Gemini Robotics; no resolution, fps or hardware figures; visual details and object permanence can drift; research preview for trusted testers.
use_zh: 实时交互、原生音频、可用语言实时修改；与 Gemini Robotics 一起做机器人演示；未给分辨率、帧率或硬件；细节与物体恒存会漂移；仅向受信测试者开放

title: 1X Technologies, 1X World Model: self-learning (2026-01-12)
label: 1X：1XWM（2026-01-12）
use: 14B video model backbone; 900 h egocentric human video plus 70 h robot data; 11 s of multi-GPU inference produces 5 s of video, then 1 s for the inverse-dynamics model; weak 3D grounding from monocular pretraining.
use_zh: 140 亿参数视频模型；900 小时第一人称人类视频＋70 小时机器人数据；多 GPU 推理 11 秒生成 5 秒视频，再用 1 秒提取动作；单目预训练导致三维定位弱

title: MuJoCo Computation
label: MuJoCo 计算与重放
use_zh: 用于核对碰撞与约束计算、积分状态、warm start 及同版本同架构的重放条件。

title: Isaac Sim Performance Optimization Handbook
label: Isaac Sim 性能手册
use_zh: 用于核对物理步长、碰撞形状、渲染和 CPU／GPU 同步的性能影响。

title: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 Multi-Tick Rendering
label: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 多速率渲染
use_zh: 用于核对物理、应用循环和传感器采样的时间语义。

title: Newton 1.7.0 Solvers
label: Newton 1.7.0 求解器
use_zh: 用于区分不同后端支持的约束、接触与可变形能力。

title: Siemens Virtual Commissioning Guideline, 109963864
label: Siemens 虚拟调试指南
use_zh: 记录 S7-PLCSIM Advanced、SIMIT 与 NX MCD 的联仿分工及信号映射。

title: Siemens Create MyVirtual Machine System Manual
label: SINUMERIK 虚拟机床手册
use_zh: 说明特定 SINUMERIK 控制器与机床工程的虚拟调试流程。

title: LinuxCNC Code Notes, Architecture Overview
label: LinuxCNC 架构概览
use_zh: 提供任务解释、运动控制与离散 I/O 的职责划分实例。
